tasks.title: Establish planning foundation
tasks.summary: Create the complete reviewable planning workspace without starting app implementation.
acceptance: Architecture, requirements, role docs and decision records are cross-linked.
Documentation checks pass and limitations are recorded.
REA preview and pending approval are documented without applying setup.

tasks.title: Prove overlay and foreground lifecycle
tasks.summary: Run a disposable, user-authorized Android spike before production scaffolding.
acceptance: Visible-Activity start, pause, stop, denial and revocation have physical-device evidence.
Window geometry, rotation, touch bounds, lock and process death are demonstrated.
Foreground type rationale and unsupported OEM behavior are recorded.

tasks.title: Prove notification and media contracts
tasks.summary: Validate public source APIs using synthetic sources.
acceptance: Snapshot/update/removal races and source reconnect are documented.
Two media sessions and supported controls are demonstrated.
Sensitive/redacted content and profile limitations are recorded.

tasks.title: Validate interaction and accessibility
tasks.summary: Review all experience states and prove accessible overlay interaction.
acceptance: Compact/expanded, denied, paused and recovery flows are reviewed.
TalkBack, 200% text, reduced motion and touch targets have device evidence.
In-app detail fallback is defined if overlay focus cannot meet criteria.

tasks.title: Review privacy and distribution feasibility
tasks.summary: Confirm data boundaries and evaluate a defensible release path.
acceptance: Permission explanation and generic preview defaults are reviewed.
Manifest, backup, logs and proposed service type have review findings.
Current distribution requirements are checked and unresolved external approval is explicit.

tasks.title: Harden modular foundations and production event engine
tasks.summary: Extend the authorized development slice after physical-device feasibility; complete production actor/epoch contracts and module boundaries.
acceptance: Gradle/JDK/SDK/library versions and dependency boundaries are pinned and validated.
Reducer ordering, expiry, invalidation and bounded queues pass adversarial tests.
Synthetic fixtures reproduce competing events with a virtual clock.

tasks.title: Integrate notification, media and charging sources
tasks.summary: Implement bounded adapters and validated action dispatch.
acceptance: Lifecycle and source-generation integration cases pass.
Only allowed sources and supported actions reach the engine.
Artwork and payload budgets, cancellation and double-tap guards are tested.

tasks.title: Build presentation, onboarding and lifecycle
tasks.summary: Implement the reviewed UI and user-controlled host session.
acceptance: Permission-denied and partial-access paths remain useful.
Start/stop, rotation, lock, revocation and process death leave no stale window or content.
Preference validation, migrations, backup exclusion and cleanup pass review.

tasks.title: Validate privacy, compatibility and performance
tasks.summary: Produce measured release evidence for each supported pilot device.
acceptance: Canonical lifecycle, adversarial and accessibility scenarios pass.
Latency, frames, memory and paired battery results meet budgets or have an approved revision.
Storage, logs, network and manifest audit finds no unexpected content persistence or egress.

tasks.title: Prepare pilot and release review
tasks.summary: Prepare a reviewed distributable and honest compatibility/disclosure materials.
acceptance: Name, namespace, license, signing and distribution choices are recorded.
Pilot feedback and requirement evidence are reviewed by the owner.
Release/distribution requirements and rollback procedure are rechecked.

tasks.title: Install and verify REA after approval
tasks.summary: Apply only the reviewed Codex integration, skill and scoped runtime changes.
acceptance: Explicit approval is recorded before setup writes.
Reviewed version, backups, registration and workflow skill pass scoped diagnostics.
Fresh MCP handshake/tool listing succeeds; active-chat visibility is verified or reported pending.
Unrelated configuration is preserved and optional providers are reported separately.
tasks.blocker: User explicitly requested setup-plan approval before installation; awaiting that approval.

tasks.title: Expand product plan from screenshot reference
tasks.summary: Record all nine reference panels, agent meaning, torch and optional provider architecture.
acceptance: Every visible feature has a mapped Android behavior and delivery task.
Kotlin kickoff authorization, privacy changes and release limitations are documented.

tasks.title: Build first Kotlin vertical slice
tasks.summary: Create buildable development app with local tools, platform adapters and labeled demo progress.
acceptance: Pinned wrapper/toolchain produces a debug APK.
Meaningful JVM domain tests and Android lint pass.
Feature status honestly separates source/build evidence, simulations and pending providers.

tasks.title: Integrate real AI agent execution and progress
tasks.summary: Replace demo-only progress with an authorized runner/connector and validated cancellation.
acceptance: Connector authentication/ownership and state revisions are verified.
Queued/running/waiting/terminal states, disconnect, cancel/retry and process death have evidence.
Tasks are never autonomously started by the island.

tasks.title: Validate and harden flashlight island
tasks.summary: Prove real hardware callback/control behavior and ownership-safe lifecycle.
acceptance: Physical-device denial/revoke, camera contention and external toggles tested.
Brightness control appears only for supported API/hardware with evidence.
Lock/stop never silently toggles an externally controlled torch.

tasks.title: Integrate AI and currency providers
tasks.summary: Choose and wire real timestamped rates/history and explicit-send streaming AI.
acceptance: Provider/credential/transport choices are recorded without APK server secrets.
Rates show quote timestamp/history freshness and offline states.
AI identifies actual model, supports cancel/error and never implicitly sends private content.

tasks.title: Complete media artwork and authorized lyrics
tasks.summary: Add bounded artwork and provider-backed timed lyrics with offset.
acceptance: Licensed/authorized source selected and unsupported state accurate.
Media actions follow advertised capabilities and correct selected session.
Lyric offset, session handoff and cache clearing are tested.

tasks.title: Complete launcher preferences and invocation
tasks.summary: Finish recents, persisted layouts, priority, shortcuts, emoji catalog and action/keyboard affordances.
acceptance: Priority/favorites/visibility/aliases/layout and app-owned recents behave and persist as specified.
Shortcut role/access spike prevents unsupported promises.
Invocation, action menus and accessibility/keyboard cases are tested; clipboard remains manual/private.

tasks.title: Document laptop and Android phone testing
tasks.summary: Provide accurate testing instructions for the current APK without claiming unrun device checks.
acceptance: Mac build checks, Studio emulator setup, targeted adb installation and phone-only APK installation are documented.
Feature tests specify actual UI labels, expected results, permission steps and pending integrations.
Existing artifacts/tool availability and official instructions are checked; documentation links pass.
